scope: T05.01/T05.02 aggregate public-source readiness; no molecular analysis, new individual linkage or admission

catalogue_snapshot.method: Parse the three pinned JSONL tables. For each target accession, assert the catalogue and source assay counts equal distinct GSM count; require both subseries and parent in every row's membership; check null participant IDs, null independent participant count, false admission and all four referenced historical request records with HTTP 200 and 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256. Compare assay-accession sets across each modality pair. Different GSM identifiers do not establish different people. No row-level identifiers emitted.

study_evidence.new_source_observation: Published methods describe simultaneous DNA and RNA extraction from fresh whole blood and two RNA-seq phases. This supports specimen-level linkage plausibility, not verified matching for each deposited assay. Anonymous age/sex-matched controls are not independently identified by demographic labels. Exclude the pooled parent measurement from individual pairing; retain family and technical control roles.
study_evidence.decision: hold individual-level analysis; candidate small prespecified directional/module corroboration only after source-specific admission, independent family/participant grouping and N0/N1

affected_pair_count_bounds_from_margins_.assumption: Both affected modality subsets lie within the 43 affected participants. Inclusion-exclusion lower bound max(0,24+17-43); upper bound min(24,17). These are conservative bounds from published margins, not estimates or observed pairs.

study_evidence.new_source_observation: Original paper explicitly names both subseries and reports institutional approvals, caregiver consent and assent as appropriate. This updates the previously incomplete article-level evidence; the source rights owner must receive it without changing scientific, redistribution or institutional status. Methylation draws from A/R/part of S; RNA-seq draws from part of S. Study-level cohort membership is not a deposited assay crosswalk. The paper already tests expression concordance with methylation and reports limited transcriptomic changes.
study_evidence.decision: hold individual-level analysis pending source-declared participant/specimen crosswalk; no join on title resemblance, ordering, variants or family labels

limitations.new_source_access: Public article/series web records inspected; ADNP supplemental PDF access returned download preparation rather than document content; supplement workbooks, clinical records, molecular matrices and raw sequence not retrieved. No exact new response-byte hashes are claimed.
limitations.source_file_inventory: Full files.jsonl connector response could not be parsed (incomplete JSONL); no file-level inventory qualification is claimed. Existing historical receipt references preserved.
limitations.novelty: Bounded prior-art and source review only; no complete dated N0/N1, clinical or device acceptance.
limitations.rights: Existing dataset-rights register and artifact-specific approval still govern; no new release or data transfer.

next_gate: T01/T05 receive an authoritative, permitted assay-person-specimen/time and family relation evidence table before individual-level pairing. If not available, restrict to prespecified disease-level confirmation or stop. Keep T02 critical path and open PRs 43/44 unchanged.
